review_type: Strict accepted-name and target-zone reconciliation of B142 handoff

sources.label: Kew Plants of the World Online — Sapindus saponaria
sources.finding: Accepted species; current native range does not include Texas.

sources.label: Kew Plants of the World Online — Sapindus drummondii
sources.finding: Accepted western soapberry; native to Texas; historical S. saponaria var./subsp. drummondii are synonyms.

sources.label: USDA GRIN — Sapindus saponaria var. saponaria
sources.finding: Native U.S. range listed as Florida, Georgia, and South Carolina; Texas is not listed.

bonap.interpretation: BONAP's county atlas is retained as the project's primary historical distribution cross-check, but its Sapindus saponaria map predates the 2024 sectional revision and does not separate current S. drummondii from old broad S. saponaria usage. It is therefore not used to override the current accepted-name range split.

range.reason: No current Texas-native treatment for Sapindus saponaria sensu stricto, so it cannot meet the project's three-target-county rule.

excluded_source_evidence.reason: Older broad soapberry naming; Hays flora explicitly identifies western soapberry as S. saponaria var. drummondii, which maps to current S. drummondii.

evidence.detail: UT PRC Hays flora lists Sapindus saponaria var. drummondii; current Kew maps that historical name to S. drummondii.
UT PRC Travis County index lists Sapindus saponaria var. drummondii; current Kew maps that historical name to S. drummondii.
CM185508: Sapindus drummondii, Kerr County near Ingram.
UT PRC Williamson County flora documents western soapberry as S. saponaria var. drummondii.
Powell's treatment explicitly lists Val Verde County for S. saponaria var. drummondii.

handoff.sapindus_saponaria: reviewed target-zone FAIL; do not install
handoff.sapindus_drummondii: retain canonical learner and media; PASS with current-target-zone basis Hays/Travis/Kerr/Williamson/Val Verde
handoff.tracker: mark all four Sapindus source concepts processed; genus should recalculate to 4/4 with zero remaining

correction.reason: B160 initially used a stale target-zone county definition.
correction.corrected_rule: Use the explicit 25-county project list dated 2026-09-30; Williamson and Val Verde are inside the current target zone.
correction.effect: Sapindus drummondii remains PASS. Target-zone evidence is Hays, Travis, Kerr, Williamson, and Val Verde. Sapindus saponaria sensu stricto remains target-zone FAIL.
